TWO CITATIONS, one per vara. Page 31 footnote 3 is the samudaya half and page 32 footnote 1 is the nirodha half. source_printed carries the page-32 one, following the rule that a citation arrives with the chant LAST page. The page-31 reference is recorded here rather than dropped.

READING HAZARD, NOT CORRECTED. The sense-bases word is written with pho at verses 4, 5, 16 and 17, and the photograph appears to agree. Standard Pali is salayatana, with lo chula. This is the same hazard proven twice on pages 22 and 23: this typeface renders lo chula so that it photographs as pho. The photograph therefore CANNOT settle it, and the instruction to let the photo win must not be applied here — doing so would fix four wrong readings in place. Needs the physical book.
